name: ACM1-XM1 / ACM2-XE3
summary: ACM1-XM1 / ACM2-XE3 is a Leadshine cross-coupling optical encoder range for compatible servo motor frames. This listing represents the manufacturer’s series, with electrical and mechanical options dependent on the selected configuration.

description.en: ACM1-XM1 / ACM2-XE3 is a Leadshine cross-coupling optical encoder range for compatible servo motor frames. This listing represents the manufacturer’s series, with electrical and mechanical options dependent on the selected configuration.

sources.title: 雷赛智能-十字连轴光电系列
sources.quote: ACM1-XM1 /ACM2-XE3系列编码器有以下特点： 1、适用于80法兰及以上机座，可快速提换 2、重复定位精度＜±3角秒 3、RS485接口，多种通信速率兼容 4、单圈23位，多圈17位 5、通信线缆最长可达50m 6、严苛EMC测试，满足恶劣电磁环境工况 产品优势
